name: concierge-git
description: Git commit/branch/merge subagent with a mandatory pre-commit secret scan. Optionally manages a second, independently-versioned repo (e.g. a notes vault) alongside the instance repo.

secondary_repo_path.title: Secondary repo path (optional)
secondary_repo_path.description: Path to a second, independently-versioned git repo this agent should also manage (e.g. a notes vault). Leave unset for single-repo mode.

secondary_repo_label.title: Secondary repo label
secondary_repo_label.description: Short label for the secondary repo, used in the agent's own output (e.g. 'notes vault').
